about.title: About The Project
about.description: Learn about OpenThrone and its development.
about.originStory: OpenThrone Project is a community-first project hoping to recreate and enhance spirit of DarkThrone which has gone dark after almost 20 years of service.
about.modernStack: OpenThrone started as a fork of "Dark Curse" project by Moppler. We have since ported it to a modern tech stack (NextJS/React) to ensure longevity and easier contribution.
about.notAffiliated: OpenThrone is not affiliated with nor endorsed by the original DarkThrone project or its creators.
about.serverStatus: The game is currently in active development. The server you are playing on is a Live Development Server.
about.mayReset: The game may be reset often, sometimes without notice.
about.featuresAdded: Features are being added and balanced daily.
about.basicMechanics: We are focused on getting basic mechanics functioning perfectly.
about.faqActive: Yes, a small group of volunteers have been working to get a working version of the game up and running. Please join the Discord or submit PRs/Issues for discussion and enhancement.
about.faqHelp: If you have experience with art, NextJS, or Figma, please reach out to the team via Discord.
about.faqIdeas: Currently we are hyper-focused on getting the basic mechanics functioning. If you have ideas, please share them on our GitHub issues page so that we can centralize the discussion and come up with the best possible implementation. Unfortunately not all ideas will be implemented, but we encourage ideas and appreciate any PR contributions.
about.shareIdeasGitHub: Currently we are hyper-focused on getting basic mechanics functioning. If you have ideas, please share them on our GitHub issues page so that we can centralize discussion and come up with the best possible implementation. Unfortunately not all ideas will be implemented, but we encourage ideas and appreciate any PR contributions.
about.licensed: OpenThrone is licensed under MIT License. Copyright © 2023.
about.contributions: OpenThrone is built and maintained by a community of contributors. You can contribute code, documentation, or help test features via our GitHub repository.
